dateLabel: The four Advent weekends, 28 November to 20 December 2026
time: Saturdays 10 am–7 pm, Sundays 11 am–5 pm
address: Market Place and Church Street, Keldwick, North Yorkshire DL8 4QF
entry: Free entry. Mulled wine comes in a Keldwick mug: £2 deposit, back at any hut.

items.title: The huts open
items.note: Forty-two wooden huts round the Market Cross and down to the church gate.

items.title: Lantern walk
items.note: Children carry the lanterns they made in class. Walk with them from the school gate.

items.title: The lights go on
items.note: Switched on by Elsie Thorpe, who has kept the toffee hut since the first market in 1994.

items.title: A choir on the cross steps
items.note: Twenty minutes of carols, a different choir each hour, from 11 until the huts close.

items.title: Father Christmas in the Corn Exchange
items.note: Until 4. £5 a child, with a small present. Queue at the Church Street door.

items.title: Make a wreath
items.note: £18 with everything you need. Eight places a day; book at the hut.

items.title: Advent service
items.note: Everyone welcome. The huts open when it ends.

items.title: Christmas stories
items.note: Read aloud for under-eights. Free, twenty minutes.

items.title: All the choirs together
items.note: Every choir of the season on the steps at once. Song sheets from the information hut.

items.title: The huts close for another year

people.name: Thorpe’s Toffee
people.role: Treacle toffee, broken with a hammer while you wait
people.note: Elsie Thorpe has had the hut beside the cross since the first market in 1994.

people.name: The Mulled Wine Hut
people.role: Mulled wine, and hot spiced apple for drivers
people.note: Run by Keldwick Rotary. 50p from every cup goes to Swaledale Hospice.

people.name: Holly & Ivy
people.note: Wreath-making at 2 every Saturday and Sunday.

people.name: Moorside Woodturners
people.role: Bowls, spinning tops and tree decorations

people.name: Fell Wool Co-operative
people.role: Hats, mittens and fleeces from local flocks

people.name: Bell’s Chestnuts
people.role: Roast chestnuts and hot pork rolls

people.name: Keldwick Library
people.note: Free, for under-eights, with a grown-up.

people.name: The information hut
people.role: Song sheets, lost children and first aid
people.note: By the Market Cross, kept by the Town Council.
